objective: Enlarge the nonlinear economic model with endogenous labor, convex capital installation costs and a labor-disutility shock; measure learned multi-output policies and finite interventions with all weights available.
teacher: richer_teacher.npz, independent numerical solution; 7 productivity by 3 labor-disutility Markov states; no linearization

data.distribution: capital uniform [.5,1.8]*kss, joint shock states sampled from stationary distribution; independent seeds and raw-state disjointness checked

training.selection: First scheduled checkpoint with every output VALIDATION RMSE <=.02 TRAIN output SD. If none qualifies, retain checkpoint minimizing worst-output VALIDATION RMSE and mark ineligible. Never select on TEST.
training.normalization: TRAIN mean and SD for every input and output

interventions.prediction: full signed connectivity with baseline downstream gates; compare local linear prediction with actual edited forward pass on all three outputs
interventions.normalization: output changes scaled by each TRAIN output SD before pooled response NRMSE
interventions.control: all final-hidden-unit removals predicted from full signed readout; exact to numerical precision
interventions.information: all model weights and biases supplied; no hidden readout, constructed redundancy, neuron duplication or refitting

labels.selection: highest absolute DISCOVERY Pearson correlation with log productivity among final hidden units (zero-variance units score zero)
labels.audit: actual removal of selected unit and remeasurement of productivity/labor-shock/capital response vectors on independent INTERVENTION_TEST backgrounds
labels.responses: capital .9*k versus 1.1*k (within domain); productivity state nearest zero versus one higher, fixed labor shock; labor shock nearest zero versus one higher, fixed productivity
labels.scope: labels are associations with known inputs; mixed correlations are not by themselves evidence of superposition or natural semantic concepts

interpretation: Report results and failed accuracy gates. Local predictor failure is a limitation of that predictor, not evidence that no explanation is possible. Exact full-circuit forward evaluation succeeds by construction. Increasing economic or network size alone does not prove increasing understanding difficulty.

authority.compute: bounded measured local CPU pilot; no paid runs
